channel.name: email
channel.note: email connect does not block init.

backends.name: agentmail
backends.summary: HTTP inbox. Connect provisions or selects an owned address

options.name: setup_method
options.help: Choose existing_credential to connect an approved API key, or create_account only when the user explicitly authorizes creating a new external AgentMail account. Account creation sends a verification code to the approved human email.

options.name: credential
options.help: Existing AgentMail API key (starts with am_). Open API Keys at https://console.agentmail.to if an operator needs to create one. For transient use, provide AGENTSELF_EMAIL_CREDENTIAL or AGENTSELF_AGENTMAIL_API_KEY on every email invocation. To store it in this identity, write the key to a file and continue with --result-file.

options.name: human_email
options.help: Human email approved for this authorized account creation. A six-digit verification code will be sent there. If signup says the identity is claimed, forbidden, or unavailable, stop and ask the user to use existing_credential; aliases are not tried.

options.name: otp
options.help: Six-digit verification code sent to the approved human email.

options.name: address
options.help: Inbox address when this key owns more than one. Use an address the provider listed. Do not invent one.

backends.name: imap
backends.summary: IMAP receive plus SMTP send. Hosts default to imap./smtp. of the address domain

options.name: address
options.help: Existing mailbox address (user@domain). Do not invent an address.

options.name: credential
options.help: Password or app password for that mailbox. Gmail and Outlook need an app password, not the login password. Env AGENTSELF_MAIL_PASSWORD. Write it to a file and continue with --result-file.

options.name: mail_host
options.help: Shared mail host when IMAP and SMTP use the same hostname.

options.name: imap_host
options.help: IMAP host override. Default is imap.<address-domain>.

options.name: smtp_host
options.help: SMTP host override. Default is smtp.<address-domain>.
